source.title: ✅【选择器】设计规范v2.0.2605A
source.method: MasterGo get_selection_node; explicit current-file node read

scope: Current admitted desktop calls: scene rules, declared states and actual source relationships; not pixel or whole-family visual approval

findings.sourceFact: Select用于表单预设值，禁用动作/导航及≤5个选项。
findings.correction: 修正短列表单选决策；已交付旧页保持固定版本，新测试数据遵守>5。

findings.sourceFact: 搜索/区号/分组属于Select配置升级。
findings.correction: 保留九个有限映射，不增加组件族或任意组合接口。

findings.sourceFact: 选择框实际嵌套无标签、无占位的基础Input。
findings.correction: 九个现有调用接入Input受控面部与共享状态；保留原combobox、多值标签及动作，宿主只分配布局。
保留现有XL真实引用，更新当前来源节点。

findings.sourceFact: 常规列表232px，双列428px；空间不足自动适配，视口安全距离20px。
findings.correction: 补面板高度约束与上/下避让、滚动和窗口变化时重算。

unverified: General width text recommends212–320px while existing double-column specimen is340px; fixed specimen widths are removed from scene decisions, final visual widths remain separately reviewable.
Source row masters use Radio/Checkbox icon atoms, not independent labeled native inputs; single-radio retains shared official glyph resources, not a fabricated whole-Radio parent reference.

listOptionSource.current: Finite PC source-backed calls and List source referral; previous findings retained as historical scope.
